subject: Stability Gate: QMon onboarding & canary deployment plan
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@luminacare.health>

Subject: Stability Gate: QMon onboarding & canary deployment plan

Hi Mina / Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. LuminaCare is excited to move from pilot to a constrained production rollout for our patient-recommendation assistant. Before we start traffic routing we want to lock down the quality monitoring (QMon) setup and the stability gate so we can catch prompt regressions early and have safe fallback behavior.

Primary asks from our side: 
- Review the attached prompt set (lumina_promptset_v1.csv) and confirm mapping to eval hooks.
- Integrate Redwood's eval harness into our CI so we get regression alerts on PRs and nightly runs.
- Define a canary policy: percent ramping, duration, and automatic rollback triggers (token-level drift, semantic regression score drop).

We'd like a short playbook that our SREs and CS can follow during the first 2-week ramp. I've attached the prompt set and a config sketch. Can you propose a concrete canary matrix and alert thresholds?

Proposed kickoff window: next Tuesday morning (6/18) — open to alternate times.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Kim
Director, Product Ops
LuminaCare
attachments: lumina_promptset_v1.csv, eval-harness-config.yaml
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Stability Gate: QMon onboarding & canary deployment plan

Sara —

Appreciate the clear asks and the attachments. Quick notes after a first pass: 

- Prompt set: looks like a good coverage of clinical intents. We'll convert your CSV to a Redwood promptset object and add standard variants for temperature and system prompt differences. Expect a PR to your Drive link with the instrumented prompt IDs and canonical reference outputs.

- Eval harness: we can provide the GitHub Action that runs the harness on PRs and the nightly job. Two things to confirm on your side: where test outputs should be stored (S3 bucket vs your GCS) and who receives regression alerts (PagerDuty vs Slack channel).

- Canary policy (proposal below):
  * Phase 1: internal smoke (0% external traffic) — 24 hours, sanity checks pass.
  * Phase 2: 1% external traffic — 6 hours. Evaluate token-level latency and semantic similarity score.
  * Phase 3: 5% external traffic — 24 hours. Add human-in-the-loop sampling (10/day).
  * Phase 4: 20% external traffic — 48 hours. If all metrics within thresholds, standard rollout.

Rollback triggers (auto):
  - Semantic regression score drops > 6 points vs baseline over a rolling 4-hour window.
  - Prompt set failure rate > 3% (exact-match diff) sustained for 30 minutes.
  - Latency P95 increase > 50% or absolute > 2s.

We'll draft the canary-runbook.pdf and the eval-harness Action and post to the Drive by EOD Friday. Can we lock the kickoff for Tue 6/18 10:00 AM PT?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior CS Engineer
Redwood Inference

Sara —

Thanks for sending this over. A couple of practical items from the CS side: 

- Ownership: LuminaCare CS will handle human review sampling and initial manual signoff for Phase 2 -> Phase 3 transitions. Redwood will provide the alerts, dashboards, and canary rollback automation.
- Ops contacts: please add your on-call alias (procure@luminacare.health) if you want auto-escalations. We'll wire the alerting to a temporary channel for the rollout.
- Access: we'll need a Pipelines token with read/write to the bucket you choose for harness artifacts. If you prefer us not to host artifacts, we can publish only summaries to your Drive.

Agenda for Tue 6/18 10:00 AM PT kickoff (30 min):
1) Quick intro (5 min)
2) Review converted promptset and baseline metrics (8 min)
3) Eval harness integration checklist (7 min)
4) Canary matrix & rollback thresholds (7 min)
) Actions & owners (3 min)

I'll be on the call and will record action items.

—Marissa

Thanks, Marissa / Mina. Tuesday 10:00 AM PT works for our team — I've added the calendar invite and included our SRE (Jared). A couple of clarifications before the call: 

- Artifacts: we prefer artifacts in our LuminaCare S3 bucket (s3://lumina-qmon-artifacts). We'll provide an IAM role for read/write; please send the least-privilege policy you need.
- PagerDuty: yes, please wire regressions to PD escalation for the initial 2-week ramp; PD alias: lumina-qmon-oncall.
- Measurement: for semantic regression we'll use a combination of embedding cosine and an LLM-based scoring test you provide. Can you confirm the scoring model version and the baseline window you'd like to lock?

Attaching our internal compliance note and procurement contact for contract-side coordination.

Sara

Sara / team —

Following our kickoff today, attaching the runbook and the eval-harness Action we agreed on. Summary of decisions and owners: 

- Baseline window: two weeks of pilot logs (May 20–Jun 3) to lock semantic baseline. Model scoring: embedding cosine + a 0–100 semantic score from the Redwood eval model v2.1.
- Artifact location: we'll write harness outputs to s3://lumina-qmon-artifacts using the IAM role you provide.
- Canary matrix finalized: Phase cadence as Mina proposed. Auto-rollback on semantic score drop > 6 points (4-hour window) or prompt failure rate > 3% sustained 30m.
- Alerts: wired to PagerDuty alias lumina-qmon-oncall, and to #lumina-qmon-temp Slack channel (redwood will create).

Attachments: canary-runbook.pdf, eval-harness-config.yaml 

Next steps: LuminaCare to provision IAM role and confirm PD alias; Redwood to open PR with instrumented prompt IDs and push the GitHub Action.

-Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference
